cohort: The study included 255 infants, divided into groups based on whether their mothers had Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM), Preeclampsia (PE), both GDM and PE, or neither.
finding: Infants born to mothers with GDM, PE, or both showed more aberrant fidgety movements, reduced age-adequate movement repertoire, abnormal postural patterns, and lower Motor Optimality Score-Revised (MOS-R) compared to typically developing infants.
